CFVigil is a solo-maintained open-source project. I don't review or merge unsolicited outside pull requests, including bug fixes and new features. Please don't open a PR expecting it to be integrated upstream.

If you've found a problem, use the [bug report form](https://github.com/morozhenko-apps/cfvigil/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). If you have an improvement in mind, use the [suggestion form](https://github.com/morozhenko-apps/cfvigil/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). Describing the problem and how it affects your work is enough; you don't need to write the fix.

You're welcome to maintain your own fork under the Apache License 2.0 license. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the project's feedback and fork policy.
